Hi Everyone! I have a question about renewing my passport. 

I'm travelling home in August and will renew my passport in my home country. I'll keep my old passport so I have my B1 visa, but I'm wondering what happens to my visa? Will I need an ETA to get back to Israel? Will the visa in my old passport still be valid or do I need a new one? 

I have 2 more trips planned before my visa renewal so I'm worried about potential issues when flying back into Israel.
